chunks.title: Who is Charan
chunks.text: I'm Charan (Bonamukkala Charan Reddy), a Generative AI engineer and developer based in Hyderabad, India. I build multi-agent AI systems, full-stack web products and websites for local businesses. I am a second-year B.Sc Computer Science student and a tech content creator. My focus is multi-agent systems and vision LLMs, and my portfolio headline is "I build AI products that actually ship".

chunks.title: Education
chunks.text: I am a second-year B.Sc Computer Science student at NIAT Hyderabad, with the degree conferred via BITS Pilani. My specialization is Generative AI, and I expect to graduate around 2028 to 2029.
variants: Which college do you go to?

chunks.title: Skills and tech stack
chunks.text:
My skills come from projects I have built.
- Languages: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript
- Frontend: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Router, Framer Motion, GSAP, Three.js, Recharts
- Backend: FastAPI, Flask, Vercel Edge Functions, Supabase Edge Functions, n8n workflows, WebSocket and SSE streaming, JWT auth
- Databases and retrieval: MongoDB, Supabase (Postgres), SQLite, Neo4j, FAISS
- AI and ML: Groq (Llama models), Gemini, CrewAI, RAG pipelines, SBERT, XGBoost, LightGBM, LSTM, SHAP, MLflow, PyTorch quantization, LoRA and QLoRA fine-tuning
- Voice AI: OmniDimension, Bolna AI, Sarvam STT/TTS, Whisper
- Deployment: Vercel, Render, Hugging Face Spaces, Docker
- Dev tools: Antigravity IDE, Claude Code, GitHub
variants: What programming languages do you know?

chunks.title: Project: RecruitMate AI
chunks.text: I built RecruitMate AI alone. It is a multi-tenant AI recruitment platform with seven specialized agents: JD parser, resume screener, question generator, AI interviewer, answer evaluator, scheduler and candidate comparator, plus an automated email sender. It helps hiring teams run high-volume pipelines without manually parsing job descriptions and evaluating answers. It also has a pipeline view, analytics and a heatmap. The stack is Flask, MongoDB, React and Groq, deployed on Vercel and Render. It uses custom JWT auth, token-based public interview links and Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA, with about 28 API endpoints. Live: https://recruit-mate-chi.vercel.app. Code: https://github.com/bonamukkala-bot/RecruitMate

chunks.title: Project: Atelier
chunks.text: Atelier is a premium furniture storefront with an admin CRM, which I built as a portfolio piece for furniture shops. Instead of a cart, customers contact the shop on WhatsApp or by call, because custom furniture buyers ask about materials, dimensions and delivery first. Features include a product catalog, multi-image admin uploads, order tracking, a Groq-powered chatbot and an English, Telugu and Hindi language toggle. I also designed a delivery system with a pincode deliverability checker, delivery zones, a public tracking page and a Razorpay test-mode deposit. The stack is React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind, Supabase, Framer Motion and Groq. A live demo is on my portfolio.
variants: Tell me about your furniture website

chunks.title: Project: IPL Win Predictor
chunks.text: I built the IPL Win Predictor alone. It is a machine learning system that predicts IPL match outcomes and explains each prediction instead of giving uncalibrated black-box guesses. It supports pre-match and live-match prediction and Monte Carlo championship odds, with SHAP explanations. It uses an ensemble of XGBoost, LightGBM, Random Forest and LSTM with isotonic calibration, trained on 17 IPL seasons with more than 26 MLflow runs tracked. The backend is FastAPI, the frontend is React with Vite and Tailwind, and it runs with Docker Compose. A live demo is on my portfolio.

chunks.title: Project: Sri Vishnu Grand PG
chunks.text: Sri Vishnu Grand PG is a production website I built for a men's hostel and paying-guest business in Gachibowli, Hyderabad. It is a real client project. The site handles inquiries automatically, presents amenities and guides prospective residents without repeated phone calls. It includes a Groq-powered chatbot with a room booking flow, WhatsApp handoff, inline Google Maps, a blog and a full SEO setup with structured data, Google Analytics and Search Console. The stack is React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, TanStack Router, Framer Motion and Groq on a Vercel Edge Function. Live: https://srivishnugrandpg.com

chunks.title: Project: AI Business Doctor
chunks.text: I built AI Business Doctor alone. It is a diagnostic platform for small-business sales and inventory data, using a medical metaphor of vitals, diagnosis, prescription and consultation. It gives a 0 to 100 health score, profit driver analysis, stop-selling detection, reorder alerts, anomaly detection and priority actions ranked by rupee impact. It also has a "Consult the Doctor" chat and PDF export. Numbers are computed deterministically in pandas and NumPy, and the LLM is used only for explanations. The stack is FastAPI, React 19, Vite, Recharts and Groq Llama 4 Scout. Live: https://ai-business-doctor.vercel.app. Code: https://github.com/bonamukkala-bot/ai-business-doctor

chunks.text: I entered HackerRank Orchestrate with an autonomous multi-agent pipeline for insurance damage-claim verification, using five sequential agents with vision LLMs. In the June 2026 edition I ranked #619 of 1,773 participants. In the May 2026 edition I earned a certificate of excellence for 1007th place. The code is in my bonamukkala-bot GitHub account.

chunks.title: Project: Sentinel Agent
chunks.text: Sentinel Agent is an AI agent I built for monitoring containerized microservices, diagnosing incidents and inspecting error patterns across Docker. It has a five-step investigation engine, a FastAPI streaming backend and a React frontend, and uses Gemini 2.5 Flash. It is deployed on Hugging Face Spaces and Vercel. Live: https://sentinel-frontend-alpha.vercel.app. Code: https://github.com/bonamukkala-bot/sentinel-agent

chunks.title: Project: JalFlow
chunks.text: JalFlow is a citizen-reporting platform for waterlogging in Hyderabad, built by me in three days for an Engineers Day hackathon campaign. Residents report waterlogging with a photo, location and severity, and a live map shows red, orange and green markers with an impact dashboard. The stack is React, Vite, Supabase, Leaflet with OpenStreetMap and Vercel.

chunks.title: Project: CodeBuddy Chrome extension
chunks.text: CodeBuddy is a Grammarly-style AI coding assistant Chrome extension that I built in April 2026 using Groq (Llama 3.3 70B), Manifest V3 and vanilla JavaScript. It can fix bugs, explain code, complete code, add docs and detect bad practices, and it has a Ctrl+Shift+K shortcut and a history panel.

chunks.title: Other projects
chunks.text:
- Stock Predictor: a regime-aware stock direction predictor for 8 NSE large-cap stocks using a Gaussian HMM, XGBoost, LightGBM, LSTM and SHAP, with FastAPI and React.
- CareerCraft AI: a seven-agent CrewAI career assistant with Neo4j, SQLite memory and Tavily job search.
- Furniture WhatsApp chatbot: built with n8n, the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API and Supabase, using RAG for descriptions and a live API for price and stock.
- MedScribe Rural: a Gemma 3 1B model fine-tuned with Unsloth and LoRA to write Telugu-English clinical SOAP notes, for the Kaggle x Google DeepMind Gemma hackathon.
- Qwen3-8B fine-tuning: QLoRA and DPO fine-tuning for structured JSON extraction and tool-call accuracy.
- NIAT Masterclass challenges on Kaggle: PyTorch INT8 quantization of a VGG16-BN traffic-sign classifier, and an Agentic RAG challenge with a tool-calling agent and FAISS.

chunks.title: Services Charan offers
chunks.text:
I offer three services to local and small businesses.
- AI chatbots and multi-agent systems: WhatsApp and web concierge bots, RAG over company documents and FAQs, multi-agent pipelines, and bilingual Telugu and English flows.
- Business websites that rank and convert: mobile-first React and TypeScript sites with local Hyderabad structured data, WhatsApp and email lead capture and fast load times.
- AI automation for small businesses: sales, inventory and expense diagnostics, internal portals, order tracking, automated reports and dashboards.
My process has three steps: discuss and scope, build and iterate with staging links, then launch on the client's domain with SSL and handoff documentation.
